<div align="justify">
  <!--
  =====================
       DESCRIPTION
  =====================
  -->
  <p>
    OctalWeb-Links is the dedicated social links module for the OctalWeb
    ecosystem. It provides a centralized, maintainable system for displaying
    OctalMesh social media links.
  </p>
